propositions: PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE=113 is asserted against a count re-derived from live ticket state, causing drift when tickets are reclassified or prefix resolution changes
The corpus constant was pinned to count 113 but live tracker now has 114 commits due to post-pin ticket reclassifications and new commits changing prefix resolution
Re-deriving corpus membership from live ticket state rather than pinning by commit identity makes the check fragile to tracker churn and causes the check to fail on main

The approach replaces count-based assertion (PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE) with identity-based pinning (PLANNING_CORPUS_COMMITS frozenset of 113 exact SHAs) to decouple the check from live ticket state changes
check-planning-corpus mode should iterate pinned SHAs directly and validate measured set identity and flagged set membership rather than re-deriving from current ticket types
Docstring must be updated to clarify that corpus is pinned by identity, not count, and that ticket labels are best-effort artifact metadata, never a gate
